note: 18 hook archetypes cho short-form video KimQ. Moi hook co template tieng Viet, visual style, SFX, va content-type mapping.

hooks.name_vi: Phan nghich / Dao lon su that
hooks.description_vi: Bat dau bang tuyen bo di nguoc niem tin pho bien. Tao friction nhan thuc ngay tu giay dau.
hooks.template_vi: [Dieu mo nguoi nghi la dung]. Sai hoan toan. / Hau het [nhom] dang [lam X]. Do la ly do ho [ket qua te].
hooks.visual_style: Text lon xuat hien tung tu — mau do hoac gold. Strike-through animation -> dung su that hien ra.
hooks.sfx_style: Buzz/error sound -> silence -> clean reveal tone
hooks.opening_frame: Single bold word on dark screen
examples_vi: AI khong thong minh hon ban. No chi nhanh hon.
Lam nhieu hon khong phai luc nao cung tot hon.
Hau het cong ty dang dau tu vao AI sai cach.

hooks.description_vi: Tiet lo mot phan thong tin, tao cau hoi trong dau nguoi xem ma chi xem tiep moi co cau tra loi.
hooks.template_vi: Co mot [dieu/cach/bi mat] ma [nhom] khong muon ban biet. / [X] lam duoc dieu nay nho [goi y mo ho]. Day la cach.
hooks.visual_style: Thong tin bi che/blur -> reveal tung phan. Progress bar chay. Dau cham hoi animation.
hooks.sfx_style: Low tension hum -> rising frequency -> abrupt cut to silence
examples_vi: Co mot loai AI ma gan nhu khong ai o Viet Nam dang dung dung cach.
Con so nay khien chung toi phai lam lai toan bo san pham.
Bi mat phia sau nhung doi nhom lam viec hieu qua x3.

hooks.name_vi: Ngat nhip / Gay soc thi giac
hooks.description_vi: Visual hoac am thanh cuc ky bat ngo trong 0.5 giay dau. Nao dung scroll vi khong nhan ra pattern.
hooks.template_vi: [Khong can text hook — visual IS the hook]. Sau 0.5s shock moi xuat hien context.
hooks.visual_style: Flash trang/gold fullscreen -> sudden cut to dark -> element xuat hien. Hoac glitch animation. Zoom dot ngot.
hooks.sfx_style: Hard cut silence -> sudden impact boom -> settle
hooks.opening_frame: Full-screen flash or unexpected visual — no text
examples_vi: Man hinh gold flash 0.3s -> toi den -> 1 so dem nguoc
Zoom in cuc nhanh vao 1 chi tiet -> pull back reveal toan canh

hooks.description_vi: Khai thac noi so bi bo lai phia sau, mat co hoi, hoac rui ro cu the.
hooks.template_vi: Neu ban khong [lam X] truoc [moc thoi gian], [hau qua cu the]. / [X% nguoi] da mat [Y] vi khong biet dieu nay.
hooks.visual_style: Countdown timer. Thanh progress can dan. Color shift tu gold -> red. Cac doi thu canh tranh vuot len.
examples_vi: Doi thu cua ban dang dung AI de lam viec nhanh hon 3 lan. Ban thi chua.
Nam ngoai, 70% doanh nghiep khong dung AI da mat thi phan.
Trong luc ban doc tin nay, doi nhom cua ho da xong viec roi.

hooks.description_vi: Con so, danh gia, logo khach hang, hoac ket qua cu the tao trust ngay lap tuc.
hooks.template_vi: [X] [doi nhom/nguoi dung/cong ty] dang dung dieu nay de [ket qua]. / Tu [X] -> [Y] trong [thoi gian].
hooks.visual_style: Counter odometer tang len. Logo wall. Testimonial quote card pop-in. Chart tang truong.
hooks.sfx_style: Counting/ticking up -> ding/success sound at peak number
examples_vi: 500 doi nhom da rut ngan thoi gian hop xuong con 15 phut.
Tu 40 gio/tuan -> 12 gio. Cung ket qua. Khac cach lam.

hooks.description_vi: Hien trang dau -> ket qua khao khat. Tao bridge giua vi tri hien tai va vi tri muon den.
hooks.template_vi: Truoc: [pain state]. Sau khi dung [X]: [dream state]. / [Thoi gian] truoc, [van de]. Hom nay, [ket qua].
hooks.visual_style: Split screen before/after. Timeline chay voi milestone points. Color shift tu gray -> gold.
hooks.sfx_style: Low drone -> build up -> bright resolution chord
examples_vi: Truoc: hop 3 tieng, khong ra quyet dinh. Sau: 20 phut, du du lieu, du hanh dong.
6 thang truoc team nay mat 2 tuan lam 1 report. Bay gio: 4 tieng.

hooks.description_vi: Cau hoi lam nguoi xem tu dat minh vao tinh huong. Hieu qua khi danh dung vao pain point.
hooks.template_vi: Ban co dang [lam X] khong? / Tai sao [nhom nguoi] luon [ket qua tot hon]? / Bao gio ban moi [muc tieu]?
hooks.visual_style: Cau hoi xuat hien tung tu, typing effect. Dau ? dap nhe. Sau do fade -> context.
hooks.sfx_style: Subtle typing -> question mark ding -> brief pause
examples_vi: Bao lau roi ban chua cam thay minh lam viec thuc su hieu qua?
Tai sao team 5 nguoi nay lam duoc viec cua 20 nguoi?
Ban co biet AI dang quyet dinh dieu gi trong cong ty ban khong?

hooks.description_vi: Hua hen mot ket qua cu the voi cac buoc ro rang. Kich hoat mode hoc cua nao.
hooks.template_vi: Cach [lam X] trong [Y phut/buoc]. / [X buoc] de [ket qua mong muon] — khong can [rao can pho bien].
hooks.visual_style: Step counter (1/3, 2/3...) hoac progress bar. List cac buoc xuat hien dan. Checkmark animation.
hooks.sfx_style: Clean neutral open -> step-by-step dings -> completion sound
hooks.opening_frame: Step indicator or numbered list start
examples_vi: 3 buoc de cat giam 60% thoi gian hop — khong can phan mem dat tien.
Cach tu dong hoa bao cao tuan trong 10 phut.
Lam the nao de AI phan tich du lieu thay ban — tung buoc.

hooks.description_vi: Xac dinh mot hanh vi sai pho bien va canh bao nguoi xem. Tao ngay cam giac 'o, do la minh'.
hooks.template_vi: Dung [lam X] ngay. / [X] loi pho bien nhat khi dung AI — va cach tranh. / Dung [X] truoc khi xem video nay.
hooks.visual_style: Warning sign / X mark animation. Red flash -> fix reveal. Strikethrough on wrong way.
hooks.sfx_style: Alarm/buzzer short -> silence -> soft correct tone
examples_vi: Dung dung ChatGPT theo cach nay ngay.
3 loi ma 90% nguoi moi dung AI mac phai — so 2 ton tien nhat.
Dung tu dong hoa truoc khi lam dieu nay.

hooks.description_vi: Mot tuyen bo manh, tu tin, nghe co ve qua lon nhung duoc backup boi noi dung video.
hooks.template_vi: Day la [tinh tu manh] [danh muc] ma ban chua thu. / [X] thay doi hoan toan cach [nhom] lam viec.
hooks.visual_style: Text lon, full screen, bold. Gold color. Minimal. Impact font. Phat no ra tu tam.
examples_vi: Day la cach lam bao cao nhanh nhat toi tung thay.
Cong cu nay dang thay doi cach hang nghin doi nhom lam viec.
AI vua lam duoc dieu ma 1 nam truoc con tuong la khong the.

hooks.name_vi: Bi mat / Thong tin noi bo
hooks.description_vi: Dinh vi thong tin nhu 'it nguoi biet', tao cam giac dac quyen cho nguoi xem.
hooks.template_vi: Chi [X%] nguoi biet dieu nay. / Dieu [cong ty/chuyen gia] khong noi voi ban ve [chu de].
hooks.visual_style: Classified/secret file reveal animation. Lock unlocking. Frosted glass clear.
hooks.sfx_style: Whisper effect -> reveal sound -> bright resolve
examples_vi: Chi 5% doi nhom ap dung dung cach nay — va ho luon di truoc.
Dieu cac cong ty AI lon khong noi voi ban ve chi phi thuc su.
Bi mat phia sau quy trinh lam viec cua nhung team hieu qua nhat.

hooks.description_vi: Khong chi neu van de ma dao sau vao noi dau truoc khi reveal giai phap.
hooks.template_vi: Ban dang danh [X tieng] moi [ngay/tuan] de [viec lap lai]. Do la [Y ngay] moi nam. Ban co the da [ket qua tot hon].
hooks.visual_style: Clock ticking, so tich luy (gio -> ngay -> tuan). Cost calculator. Negative space growing.
hooks.sfx_style: Slow ticking -> escalating -> breaking point sound -> release
examples_vi: Trung binh 1 nhan vien ton 11 tieng/tuan cho meeting. Nhan 50 tuan. Do la gan 3 thang lam viec. Moi nam.
Moi lan ban tong hop bao cao thu cong = 3 tieng. Moi tuan. 52 tuan. Tinh di.
Team cua ban dang mat bao nhieu tien vao nhung viec AI co the lam thay?

hooks.description_vi: So lieu bat ngo, cu the, va counterintuitive. Con so phai du lon hoac du nho de gay ngac nhien.
hooks.template_vi: [X%] cua [nhom] dang [thuc te gay soc]. / Chi [X] trong [Y] [nhom] co the [ket qua dang ngac nhien].
hooks.visual_style: Large percentage/number odometer. Pie chart explosion. Bar graph snap comparison.
hooks.sfx_style: Build up -> reveal ding -> short pause of disbelief
hooks.opening_frame: Large number or percentage on screen
examples_vi: 78% nguoi dung AI chua bao gio thu tinh nang nay.
Chi 12% doi nhom noi ho hai long voi cach hop hien tai.
Trung binh moi nhan vien nhan 121 email/ngay. Va doc duoc 23%.

hooks.description_vi: Keo nguoi xem vao mot tinh huong cu the. Nao nguoi duoc lap trinh de nghe cau chuyen.
hooks.template_vi: Ngay do, [nhan vat] dang [tinh huong]. Khong ai nghi [dieu bat ngo] co the xay ra. / Toi nho luc [ky uc cu the]...
hooks.visual_style: Scene setting: date/time stamp. Location indicator. Single character silhouette. Cinematic letterbox.
hooks.sfx_style: Ambient environmental sound -> story beat music -> momentum build
examples_vi: Thang 3 nam ngoai, mot cong ty 200 nguoi phai lam lai toan bo quy trinh trong 2 tuan.
Cuoc hop keo dai 4 tieng. Khong ra duoc quyet dinh nao. Dieu do thay doi moi thu.
Khi chung toi lan dau thay con so nay, khong ai tin do la that.

hooks.description_vi: Moi nguoi xem tham gia mot thu thach hoac thi nghiem. Tao active participation.
hooks.template_vi: Thu lam [X] trong [Y ngay/gio] va bao ket qua. / Xem ban co nhan ra [X] khong — cau tra loi o cuoi video.
hooks.visual_style: Challenge badge/seal animation. Countdown. Interactive-looking UI. Participation counter.
hooks.opening_frame: Challenge badge or game UI element
examples_vi: Thu ap dung quy tac nay trong 1 tuan va xem team ban thay doi the nao.
Toi thach ban thu lam bao cao nay theo cach AI — chi can 15 phut.
Tra loi cau hoi nay truoc khi xem tiep — roi so sanh voi dap an cuoi video.

hooks.description_vi: Nao nguoi thich structure va biet truoc so diem can xem. Tao expectation va completion drive.
hooks.template_vi: [X] dieu ban can biet ve [chu de]. / [X] ly do [nhom] luon [ket qua]. / [X] buoc de [muc tieu].
hooks.visual_style: Number/bullet counter visible. Check off animation. Progress through list.
hooks.sfx_style: Clean intro -> numbered dings for each point -> summary close
hooks.opening_frame: X/total counter or numbered list preview
examples_vi: 5 cach AI dang thay doi cach doi nhom lam viec — so 3 bat ngo nhat.
4 ly do bao cao thu cong lang phi tien cua ban.
3 cong cu mien phi de tu dong hoa 40% cong viec lap lai.

hooks.name_vi: Dong cam / Nhan ra ban than
hooks.description_vi: Mo ta chinh xac cam giac hoac tinh huong ma nguoi xem dang trai qua. Tao 'o, do chinh la minh' moment.
hooks.template_vi: Neu ban dang cam thay [cam xuc/tinh huong cu the], video nay danh cho ban. / Ban da bao gio [trai nghiem frustrating] chua?
hooks.visual_style: Intimate close-up text. Warm tones. Conversational feel. Person silhouette.
hooks.sfx_style: Soft, warm ambient -> personal intimate tone
examples_vi: Neu ban dang cam thay team minh chay nhieu nhung tien it, video nay danh cho ban.
Ban da bao gio ngoi trong hop ma khong hieu minh dang quyet dinh gi chua?
Lam viec khong thieu co gang — chi thieu dung cong cu. Nghe quen khong?

hooks.name_vi: Cu hich thi giac thuan tuy
hooks.description_vi: Khong can text trong 2 giay dau. Chi visual/motion du manh de khien nao phai dung lai phan tich.
hooks.template_vi: [Khong co text template — visual IS the content]. Sau visual hook moi reveal context.
hooks.visual_style: Rapid zoom, glitch, unexpected color burst, morphing shapes, particles explode/converge. Full bleed. No text for first 2s.
hooks.sfx_style: Pure sound design: impact, swoosh, glitch, or complete silence as contrast
hooks.opening_frame: Pure visual motion — no text for first 2 seconds
examples_vi: 1 trieu diem du lieu hoi tu thanh 1 con so — khong loi giai thich
Man hinh split: chaos trai / order phai — roi cat sang san pham
Glitch animation -> clean UI reveal
